bull.b: Durable, immunomodulator-free improvements across dermatomyositis, lupus nephritis and systemic sclerosis support rese-cel’s potential clinical value. Sustained effects across muscle, kidney, skin and lung measures could strengthen the platform’s differentiation as development advances.

The reported safety outcomes provide important support for continued development of an engineered T-cell therapy in autoimmune disease. Low rates of serious immune-related complications may improve the program’s benefit-risk profile and support broader clinical adoption if efficacy remains durable.

The warrant proceeds materially strengthen funding flexibility for ongoing clinical programs and operating needs, while relatively modest debt limits balance-sheet pressure. Together, these factors give Cabaletta more capacity to pursue development milestones before additional financing is required.

bear.b: Cabaletta remains entirely dependent on research progress and future product commercialization because it has generated no revenue across the reported periods. This leaves the company without internally generated sales to fund operations and makes clinical execution central to future financial sustainability.

The widening loss trajectory shows that operating costs are increasing faster than any path to commercial revenue, leaving profitability dependent on successful clinical development and eventual launches. Persistent losses can consume capital, reduce financial flexibility, and increase reliance on external funding.

Increasing operating and free-cash-flow outflows indicate a rising funding requirement as Cabaletta advances its programs. Even with recent capital raised, sustained burn can shorten the period covered by available resources and may require future financing that could dilute existing shareholders.
